about: Plans an agent proposes on its own (passation-pro briefs/design-agents-proactifs.md §3, §2.3, §6 row 5, §7.2; Alex 22/11: Q1 B, Q3 A, Q4 A, Q9, D2 A, D3 A; texts validated 22/11 08:53). A trip, an appointment or a habit is ONE card (`bip-plan-<id>`): its moments, the mail it watches, « Prévoir » / « Non merci ». Nothing runs before « Prévoir »; then each moment is a one-time routine whose words are written beforehand, delivered at its time by the bridge WITHOUT the model; what the plan watches goes through the bridge's own watches (an e-mail trigger on the senders' domains, the phone's calendar copy), free while nothing moves. Drafts only: nothing is sent, booked or paid. The bridge keeps them (bridge-rs/src/plans.rs, `<data>/plans.json` 0600); « Initiative » (contracts/proactive) gates them. Read by bridge/tests_blackbox/test_plans.py and plans.rs' tests (the bridge), and by the apps' PlanCard (branches plans-ios, plans-android). Additions only: an app 1.0 draws the generic Yes / No card it already draws for any unknown `bip-` card.

tool.name: plan_propose
tool.listed: To the person's own agents whose « Initiative » is not off (contracts/proactive: basic or smart) and whose « Routines » are on (routines.rs `enabled`); never to an agent other people talk to (the family's, a project's, a shared one: vault.rs `others_facing`). Off or others-facing: not listed, and a call is refused.

arguments.title: 1 to 60 characters, plain text (« Lisbonne », « Dentiste », « Boire plus d’eau »)
arguments.zone: optional, an IANA zone (« Europe/Lisbon »): the plan's place; default the person's zone (dates/mod.rs)
arguments.city: optional, 1 to 40 characters: the place's name in the person's language, for « · heure de {city} »; default the zone's last part (« Lisbon »)
arguments.moments: 1 to 6 (habit: exactly 1): {at, zone?, what (1–80), say (1–240), link?, urgent?, route?}
arguments.moment.at: « YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM » in the moment's zone (its own `zone`, else the plan's), or an ISO date-time with its offset; in the future. A habit's: its first day (optional: from tomorrow). A route moment's: none (the bridge computes it).
arguments.moment.what: the moment's line on the card, plain text
arguments.moment.say: what the bridge delivers at that time, as written (one Boîte line, no model), plain text: no markup, no line breaks, links in https only
arguments.moment.link: optional, an https URL, added to `say` when not in it
arguments.moment.urgent: optional: at the system's urgent level (Time Sensitive on the iPhone, Android 1.1's « Urgent » channel), described to the agent as « only for a moment that must be on time: when to leave, a check-in opening ». A route moment is always urgent. At most 2 urgent moments per plan (a route counts), never for a habit (review 1, R3).
arguments.moment.route: optional, {to (1–200), arrive_by (« YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM » in the moment's zone), mode: walking | driving | transit, from? (1–200)}: nothing goes to a geocoder or a router while the card waits, nor after « Non merci » (review 2, R9): at « Prévoir » only, the bridge geocodes `to` and the start (Nominatim, as `map_image`, cached in memory), then asks the time by the streets for both points rounded to 3 decimals, about 100 m (FOSSGIS's OSRM, map_route.rs `seconds`: coordinates only, no path, nothing kept on disk; transit: by car × 1.5); it writes the moment itself: at = arrive_by − the way − 5 min, rounded down to 5 min; `what` and `say` = `texts.<lang>.route`. The start: `from` when the agent gives it; else the person's home, the « Coordonnées » entry this agent may read whose label (or « Indications ») says home (« Domicile », « Perso », « Appartement », « Mon adresse », « Home », « Zuhause », « Casa »…, in fr, en, de, es, it; never one whose label says work, someone else's home or a holiday one; never just the first entry); none: refused, the refusal saying a `from` waits for « Prévoir » too. Until « Prévoir » the moment is `pending`, at = arrive_by, `what` = `say` = texts.<lang>.route_pending, its when_text « <day> <date> · texts.<lang>.before » (« jeu. 26 · avant 15:00 »); not timed at « Prévoir » (the home gone, not found, no way): left out, one Boîte line texts.<lang>.route_failed
arguments.repeat: habit only, required: {days: daily | weekdays | weekends | [mon, tue, wed, thu, fri, sat, sun], times: [« HH:MM »] (1 to 4), weeks: 1 to 12}. Each time of day is one routine on a clock « vers » that time (a stable shift of −10 to +10 min from the plan's id, Alex Q7 A), ending after `weeks` weeks (its number of runs)
arguments.watch: optional, {mail_from: [{name (1–40), domain}] (1 to 3)}: plain host names (« flytap.com »). Needs a mailbox this agent reads, and room for one more of its e-mail or link routines (20 at most); else the plan is made without it and the agent is told (« Not watched: »). Its headers only (design §3.4, §3.7; review 1, R2): a message whose From ADDRESS is at one of the domains or under one (« mail.flytap.com »), never its display name nor a domain that only contains it; the bridge fetches its headers only when only plans watch that mailbox; the agent's turn (one per e-mail of theirs, §3.8, budget 20 000 tokens) reads the sender's address, the subject and the date, never the text, and can't open it: the mailbox's tools (`mail_*`) are refused in that turn (review 2, R10)
arguments.event: optional, {source: « phone », id}: an event of the phone's calendar copy (calendar.rs) this agent reads; moved, the moments move with it; cancelled, the plan goes (§3.4). A repeating event (marked `recurring`, or several occurrences with that id: both phones give every occurrence the same id) is never followed: the plan is made without it and the agent is told (« Not followed: »). An event whose calendar left the copy is not cancelled (review 1, B2, R5). Since plans-sources (§6 row 7, contracts/plans-sources `calendar.follow`), also {source: « google » | « caldav », id}: an event of Google Calendar or of a mailbox's CalDAV calendar this agent reads, its id as calendar_list gives it, read again every hour by the bridge's `calendar_event` watch (the same lines, no model)

tool.offers: `bip_plan.offers`: the ids of its offers shown on its card (pills) still waiting (an app before fix-j68 reads these). `bip_plan.pills` (fix-j68, 24/11): every pill of the card, waiting or answered, in the order they were made, ready to draw: {id, run_id, state: waiting | accepted | refused | expired, text}; `text` is a waiting pill's question, an accepted one's words with ✓ and without « ? » (« ✓ Je te fais la liste de bagages »: drawn in the plan's card, never as a line apart), a refused or expired one's question (the apps 1.1 leave those out). The answered item of a pill in the conversation (approvals_log.rs) says `pill_of`: its plan's id (the apps 1.1 draw no line for it; an app 1.0 draws its generic answered line).

answers_to_the_agent.made: « Plan card made: … It waits for your person's « Prévoir » or « Non merci »; nothing runs before. Don't ask them again in words. »
answers_to_the_agent.refused: Every refusal starts with « Not done: » and says why in one sentence; nothing is kept, no card.

caps.about: Help without bothering (D2 A, §3.2). « Asked »: made in a turn of the person's own conversation with no relative's or other household's turn going on (agent_tools.rs `persons_own_call`, the same as « Initiative »'s off switch: runs.rs `persons_own_turn`, shared_pages.rs `who`); anything else (a routine's, a watcher's, a trigger's, a task's turn, another agent's ask by « message_agent », no turn at all) is « unasked ». The day is the person's (their zone).

card.fields: agent, run_id, request_id (<id>), command (« plan_propose · <title> »), description (= bip_summary), choices, created_at, session_id, bip_summary, bip_detail, bip_plan
card.bip_summary: texts.<lang>.summary (the app 1.0's whole card); a habit counts its runs
card.bip_detail: One line per moment « <when_text> — <what> : <say> » (a habit: « <rhythm_text> — <what> : <say> »), then the watch line, then texts.<lang>.under_i; on the first plan card of each agent, texts.<lang>.first_card after it
card.bip_plan: {id, kind, title, agent (its shown name), moments: [{id, at (Unix seconds), zone, when_text, what, say, urgent, route: bool, pending: bool (a route from home, timed at « Prévoir »)}], rhythm_text (habit, else null), watch_text (null when it watches nothing), offers: [], top (finitions 1.1, an addition an app 1.0 ignores: the card's top line texts.<lang>.top, a habit's texts.<lang>.top_habit, in the agent's language like the rest of the card)}
card.when_text: « <day> <date> · HH:MM » in the moment's zone, then texts.<lang>.other_zone when that zone is not the person's (« mer. 25 · 10:50 · heure de Lisbonne »). Days: fr lun. mar. mer. jeu. ven. sam. dim. · en Mon Tue Wed Thu Fri Sat Sun · de Mo. Di. Mi. Do. Fr. Sa. So. · es lun. mar. mié. jue. vie. sáb. dom.
card.push: The existing card notification (contracts/notifications/types/card.json, variant `plan`: key `plan_request` → `t: mail_card`, the neutral « Une demande attend ton accord »; `r` the card's run id), its sealed words texts.<lang>.notification; pushed even under « Seulement le critique »: `plan` is critical (approval_level.rs)

answers.name: once

answer.watch: true | false, only when the plan watches e-mails

answers.about: « Prévoir »: every moment not skipped and still to come becomes a one-time routine (its `say`, `urgent`, `plan`); a route from home is timed first (R1); a habit its routines on a clock; the watch its e-mail trigger (made by the plan: on at once); the phone event watched. A moment already passed is left out (`passed`: the folded line says « un était passé »). What can't be set up says so in one Boîte line, no model: a route not timed (texts.<lang>.route_failed, the moment left out), the watch not made (texts.<lang>.watch_failed, `watch: false`; review 1, R6). An app 1.0's « Oui » sends no `skip`: the whole plan.

answers.name: once_skip
answers.about: An app 1.1's « Prévoir » with moments unticked: those are left out.

answers.name: deny
answers.about: « Non merci »: forgotten; its title's print kept 14 days, so the same plan is not proposed again.

answers.name: unknown_word
answers.about: Anything else changes nothing: the card keeps asking.

after.routines: Each moment is a routine `once` in « Ce que tes agents font tout seuls » (an app 1.0 lists it as any « Une seule fois »), its job view with `plan` (the plan's id), `say` (the words it delivers) and `urgent`. `GET /v1/autonomous?plan=<id>` lists only that plan's: its moments and its e-mail watch (a `trigger` item).
after.moment: At its time the bridge delivers `say` (+ `link`) as written: one Boîte message where the card showed for the person (card_place.rs `report`: their conversation; never a hidden one, a routine's run or another agent's ask, review 1, B1: the main conversation then), pushed as a `boite` (urgent: the `urgent` variant of contracts/notifications/types/boite.json, background_turn.rs `deliver_urgent`), no turn of the model, even with the month's credit used. The « a bougé / annulé » lines and those of « Prévoir » land there too.
after.moved: The phone's calendar copy shows the event at another time: every moment moves by the same delta, one Boîte line texts.<lang>.moved, no model.
after.cancelled: The event is gone from a copy that covers its day: the plan, its routines and its trigger go, one Boîte line texts.<lang>.cancelled, no model.
after.end: One day after its last moment (a habit: after its last run), the plan, its routines and its trigger go without a word.
after.waiting_lapsed: A card still waiting when its last moment has passed goes without a word.
after.turned_off: « Initiative » turned off: the cards still waiting go without a word; what was set goes on (the person asked for it).

app_1_0.about: What an app 1.0 (iPhone and Android) already does with a card whose run id it doesn't know: its generic card (no app change). Not checked by the apps yet: no app reads contracts/plans/; to check on both 1.0 apps with int-1.1 (« apps 1.0 contre le pont 1.1 »).
app_1_0.draws: bip_summary as the card's sentence, bip_detail under « i », « Oui » / « Non » sending `once` / `deny` (no `skip`: the whole plan), the notification's sealed words
app_1_0.routines: the moments as « Une seule fois » routines; `plan`, `say`, `urgent` ignored

rules.apostrophes: The bridge writes the apps' typographic apostrophe (’); the design note's straight ones are the same words.
rules.plurals: n = 1: « 1 moment », « 1 moment » (en), « 1 Moment », « 1 momento »; « 1 semaine », « 1 week », « 1 Woche », « 1 semana ».
rules.lang: The agent's language (names.rs `agent_language`); another than these four: English.
rules.new: route_pending, before, route_failed and watch_failed (review 1, 22/11: a route timed after « Prévoir », a watch or a route that could not be set up): validated by Alex on 22/11 as written, en/de/es the same wording.

fr.rhythm_example: En semaine vers 10 h et 15 h · 2 semaines
fr.watch: Je surveille les e-mails de {name} : un changement, je te le dis.
fr.under_i: Rien n’est envoyé ni réservé : des rappels, au bon moment.
fr.first_card: Tu règles ses propositions en bas de sa page.
